item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dngos grub rgyal po gtor ma'i cha lag
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pa'i (pas) lcags mo phag lo'i zla 8 tshes 1” nyin bar la/ ka ke'u seng ge'i yang rdzong nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas spyan drangs shing / slar bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong kyi (gi)dbu rtse nas shog ser la bod yig tu bsgyur ba grub pa'o//
